t: What Perovskite Tandem Solar Cells Is
title: What Perovskite Tandem Solar Cells Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Perovskite tandem solar cells stack a perovskite top cell over a silicon bottom cell, capturing different parts of sunlight in each layer. The combination pushes efficiency past 33% — beyond silicon's practical limit — using cheap, printable materials. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Perovskite Tandem Solar Cells: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Perovskite Tandem Solar Cells in one line: Perovskite tandem solar cells stack a perovskite top cell over a silicon bottom cell, capturing different parts of sunlight in each layer.
Why it matters: They break silicon's efficiency ceiling with materials that cost pennies per watt to make..
Where it is used: rooftop solar, utility farms, building-integrated PV, space power..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
